title: Screen: wakes up and opens the drying page by itself when drying is started from somewhere else (for example from Fluidd), and wakes up when drying ends
note: Where the screen program reads the drying state from the printer, a debug-log call is replaced by 10 instructions that react only when the state changes, and queue a callback on the program's own thread-safe GUI queue. The callback wakes a sleeping screen exactly like a touch does (backlight on, screen_state=1 so the chamber light follows, inactivity timer reset, so the screen goes to sleep again by itself later). When the new state is 'drying' it also opens 'Page_Filament_Drying', unless the drying page is already shown. Code: 41 instructions in the free part of .q2_queue_text; the last state is kept in a free slot of .q2_queue_state.
